handoff.purpose: Chunk covering the final phase of _remove_tree_no_follow, remove_tree_no_follow wrapper, GitWorktreeManager init and allocation bookkeeping, and the containment refusal helpers.

symbols.name: remove_tree_no_follow
symbols.note: Public wrapper delegating to _remove_tree_no_follow; exists to avoid private import and shutil.rmtree, and to be monkeypatchable.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager
symbols.note: Manages isolated git worktrees; records allocations in memory and on disk, tracks primary checkout identity no-follow.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager.__init__
symbols.note: Resolves repo_path, initializes in-memory allocations dict, records leaf and ancestor path identities no-follow.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._run_git
symbols.note: Runs git subprocess, returns stdout stripped, raises RuntimeError on CalledProcessError.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._alloc_file
symbols.note: Returns sha256 digest of _key(worktree_path) with .json suffix under alloc dir.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._record_allocation
symbols.note: Writes allocation record before git worktree add; includes schema, path, repo, branch, created_ts.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._write_allocation
symbols.note: Makes alloc dir and writes JSON record.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._read_allocation
symbols.note: Reads and validates allocation record; returns None on reparse point, missing, parse error, schema mismatch, path/repo mismatch.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._refuse
symbols.note: Constructs WorktreeContainmentError with reason and repo/worktree_root context.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._reach_chain
symbols.note: Returns path chain from worktree_root to target; raises _refuse on ValueError.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._refuse_if_repo_adjacent
symbols.note: Refuses if candidate is within or contains repo_path.

symbols.name: GitWorktreeManager._refuse_if_the_primary_checkout_moved
symbols.note: Docstring-only in this chunk; no implementation body shown.

observations.what: The docstring for _refuse_if_the_primary_checkout_moved describes three checks including the leaf and ancestor identity comparisons, but the implementation body is not present in this chunk.
The comment 'Children before parents' claims a specific queue ordering invariant, but the queue logic is not visible in this chunk.

The _read_allocation method checks for reparse point on the record file, but does not check whether the allocation directory itself is a reparse point; the comment claims the on-disk allocation directory is candidate-writable.

The _refuse method constructs an error with 'Nothing was removed.' but the caller may have already removed some directories in _remove_tree_no_follow before raising WorktreeRemovalRace; the message in that raise says 'PARTIALLY REMOVED' instead, so the _refuse message is not used in that path.
The _run_git method raises RuntimeError with stderr but does not include stdout, which may contain useful diagnostic information.
